answer: An copycat running 35 aliases as a result needs 100 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in lagoon, expire in comet, and voyage lists each expiry. A farm of 975 identities would post 2057 proofs and burn roughly 13 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
